hooks.name: No Date.now() in Game Core
hooks.description: After a save under src/lib/game, runs node on ESLint's JavaScript bin for haunted/no-wall-clock. The path comes from the {{filePath}} argument, KIRO_FILE_PATH, or stdin JSON (event.file_path, event.filePath, or filePath). A relative path is resolved from the repo root. A path outside the repo, or a missing, blank, unexpanded, or absent path, warns on stderr and exits 0. A violation exits 1. If ESLint exits 2, or exits nonzero with empty stdout, its stderr is printed and the hook exits 1. PostFileSave cannot block the save.
